concepts.title: Cube Numbers
concepts.definition: The numbers 1, 8, 27, ... are called perfect cubes or cube numbers. Each of them is obtained when a number is multiplied by taking it three times: 1 = 1 x 1 x 1 = 1^3; 8 = 2 x 2 x 2 = 2^3; 27 = 3 x 3 x 3 = 3^3. 9 is not a perfect cube. Cubes of even numbers are even and cubes of odd numbers are odd. Numbers like 1729, 4104, 13832 are known as Hardy-Ramanujan Numbers; they can be expressed as a sum of two cubes in two different ways.
concepts.formula: n^3 = n x n x n
concepts.key_idea: A cube number is a number taken three times as a factor.

concepts.title: Cubes and Their Prime Factors
concepts.definition: Each prime factor of a number appears three times in the prime factorisation of its cube. In the prime factorisation of any number, if each factor appears three times, then the number is a perfect cube. For example 216 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 2^3 x 3^3 = (2 x 3)^3 = 6^3, so 216 is a perfect cube; 500 = 2 x 2 x 5 x 5 x 5 is not a perfect cube.
concepts.formula: each prime factor appears 3 times = perfect cube
concepts.key_idea: Perfect cube: every prime factor in a group of three (triplet).

concepts.title: Smallest Multiple that is a Perfect Cube
concepts.definition: To make a number a perfect cube, look at the prime factorisation: if a prime does not appear in a group of three, multiply or divide by the smallest number so that every prime gets a triplet. For example 392 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 7 x 7, so we need one more 7 and 392 x 7 = 2744 is a perfect cube. For division, divide out the primes that have no triplet, e.g. 53240 divided by 5.
concepts.formula: multiply (or divide) by the product of primes lacking a triplet
concepts.key_idea: Complete (or remove) ungrouped primes so all primes form triplets.

concepts.title: Cube Roots
concepts.definition: Finding the square root, as you know, is the inverse operation of squaring. Similarly, finding the cube root is the inverse operation of finding cube. We know that 2^3 = 8, so we say that the cube root of 8 is 2. The cube-root symbol is written with a small 3. For example cube root of 27 = 3, cube root of 125 = 5, cube root of 1000 = 10.

concepts.title: Cube Root by Prime Factorisation
concepts.definition: To find a cube root by prime factorisation, write the prime factorisation and group the factors in triples; take one factor from each triplet and multiply. For example 3375 = 3 x 3 x 3 x 5 x 5 x 5 = 3^3 x 5^3 = (3 x 5)^3, therefore cube root of 3375 = 3 x 5 = 15. Similarly 74088 = 2^3 x 3^3 x 7^3, therefore cube root of 74088 = 2 x 3 x 7 = 42.
concepts.formula: cube root = product of one factor from each triplet
concepts.key_idea: Group primes in triples; take one from each triple and multiply.
